calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(quantity) AS units, sum(net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(l.sale_date,r.business_date) AS d, l.net, r.net_sales_before_returns, l.units, r.units_sold, l.receipts, r.receipts AS r_receipts
FROM l FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') r ON r.business_date=l.sale_date
WHERE l.net IS NULL OR r.net_sales_before_returns IS NULL OR l.net<>r.net_sales_before_returns OR l.units<>r.units_sold OR l.receipts<>r.receipts
ORDER BY 1
calls.output_preview:
d | net | net_sales_before_returns | units | units_sold | receipts | r_receipts
(0 rows)

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units_booked_in_period
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.sku IN (101624,101778,102244,102233,103670,102468,103545,102213)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.sku
LIMIT 3
